previous_statement: Bijectivity. If C_nest*t<1, W_1:S^A_P->S^{A_R}_a is a linear bijection, and hence T=W_1 composed with v is bijective.
new_statement: Bijectivity. Node 1.1.1 makes W_1 a linear map S^A_P->S^{A_R}_a with ||W_1(X)-X||<=C_nest*t||X||. If C_nest*t<1 and W_1(X)=0, then ||X||<=C_nest*t||X||, hence X=0, so W_1 is injective. Lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport, specialized to Q=P as in node 1.1.1, gives equality of the finite dimensions of its domain and codomain; therefore W_1 is surjective and hence bijective. Since v:B->S^A_P is bijective by the assumed extended t-isomorphism, T=W_1 composed with v is bijective.
